The '''XI7 Turbolaser''' was a type of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]-grade [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] emplacement that was manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. Cannons of this model were installed aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], which was designed and built by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].
